'''Khalida Inayat Noor''' is a Pakistani [[mathematician]] who is known for work on topics such as [[mathematical analysis]], [[variational inequality|variational inequalities]], and [[integral operator]]s. She was awarded the [[Pride of Performance Awards (2010-2019)|Pride of Performance]] by the [[President of Pakistan]] in 2011.<ref>[https://tribune.com.pk/story/136304/truly-triumphant/ Khalida Inayat Noor's Pride of Performance Award in 2011 on The Express Tribune (newspaper)] Published 22 March 2011, Retrieved 28 October 2019</ref>

==Biography==
Khalida Noor got her [[master's degree|master's]] and [[bachelor's degree]] from [[University of the Punjab]] in [[Lahore]] in 1967 and 1965 respectively. She received her [[Master of Philosophy]] in mathematics from [[University of Islamabad|Islamabad University]] in 1968 and a Ph.D. from [[University of Wales|Wales University]] in 1972.<ref name="HEC" /> From 1980 to 1981, she was a student advisor and member of the [[Board of Studies]] at [[Islamia University]], [[Bahawalpur]] and from 1982 to 1988 was an ''Equivalence Committee'' member in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]].<ref name="GeoCities">{{cite web|url= http://www.geocities.ws/noorkhalida/kcv.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|website=GeoCities.org website|access-date=28 October 2019}}</ref>

In 2010, she was a member of the editorial board of many international journals of mathematics and engineering sciences, and had as many as 800 research papers published in scientific journals.<ref name=HEC/> She is also a member of the [[Higher Education Commission of Pakistan]] and a [[Chartered Mathematician]] in the [[United Kingdom]].<ref name=HEC/> Besides those qualifications, she also is a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]].<ref name=HEC>{{cite web|url=http://www.hec.gov.pk/InsideHEC/Divisions/HRD/FacultyHiringPrograms/FFHP/Pages/KhalidaInayat.aspx |title=Hiring of Foreign Faculty (For one year or more) (Profile of Khalida Inayat Noor)|publisher=[[Higher Education Commission of Pakistan]] |access-date=28 October 2019 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304002842/http://www.hec.gov.pk/InsideHEC/Divisions/HRD/FacultyHiringPrograms/FFHP/Pages/KhalidaInayat.aspx |archive-date=March 4, 2016 }}</ref> Noor is a professor of mathematics in the [[United Arab Emirates University]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://arnetminer.org/person/khalida-inayat-noor-626295.html|title=Profile of Khalida Inayat Noor|access-date=28 October 2019|archive-date=31 July 2013|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130731104636/http://arnetminer.org/person/khalida-inayat-noor-626295.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In October 1996, one of her papers appeared in the ''[[Journal of Mathematics]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mathlab.math.scu.edu.tw/mp/pdf/S22N49.pdf |author=Khalida Inayat Noor |title=Some Classes of Starlike Functions |volume=22 |issue=4 |pages=553–566 |date=October 1996 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303212225/http://mathlab.math.scu.edu.tw/mp/pdf/S22N49.pdf |archive-date=3 March 2016|access-date=28 October 2019}}</ref>

==Recognition==
She is a fellow and member of the following Scientific Societies:
*Member, [[American Mathematical Society]], United States<ref name=GeoCities/>
*Life Member, Punjab Mathematical Society, Pakistan
*Fellow, [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]], U.K.<ref name=GeoCities/>
